prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headache radiating to the occipital region. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Cervical strain was diagnosed. Plain radiographs of the cervical spine were unremarkable.

Treatment consisted of eight outpatient visits and included manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, a home stretching and postural program, and graded return to normal activities. Over the course of care, range of motion improved steadily, pain decreased from moderate to mild, and headache frequency diminished. The patient was advised to use ice or heat as needed and to avoid heavy lifting during the acute phase.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported substantial improvement and was able to perform daily activities and work duties without significant limitation. Residual mild stiffness remains, which is expected to resolve with continued home exercise. Discharge from active care is recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
